title: Fast prototyping of memristors for ReRAMs and neuromorphic computing.
abstract: The growing demand for energy-efficient computing in artificial intelligence requires novel memory technologies capable of storing and processing information. Memristors stand out in thanks to their ability to store information, mimic synaptic behavior and support in-memory computing architectures while requiring minimal active areas and energy consumptions. Here is presented a scalable and cost-effective approach to fabricate Ag/MoS
